meta.name: ktx-analytics
meta.description: Use when answering a question that needs data from a ktx-connected database - investigating, analyzing, "how many", "show me", "what's the breakdown of", finding records by value, exploring tables, comparing periods, explaining metrics, or any data-analysis request. Triggers even when the user does not say "analytics"; if the answer requires querying a configured ktx connection, this skill applies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言查询数据库获取分析结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过对话快速查询数据库并分析数据。
copy.tagline_en: Query databases with natural language for analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly query and analyze data via conversation.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先探索数据库结构，然后通过语义层或 SQL 查询来回答数据分析问题，并解释结果来源。
howto.when: 当你问“有多少”、“展示”、“按什么分类”等需要从已连接的 ktx 数据库获取数据的问题时触发。

say.text: 上个月的总销售额是多少？
say.note: Claude 会查询数据库并返回结果。

say.text: 按地区展示客户数量分布。
say.note: Claude 会分组统计并展示表格。

say.text: 对比今年和去年同期的订单量。
say.note: Claude 会进行时间对比分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first explore the database structure, then answer data analysis questions via semantic layer or SQL queries, and explain the source of results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask questions like "how many", "show me", "breakdown of" that require data from a configured ktx database connection.

say_en.text: What were total sales last month?
say_en.note: Claude will query the database and return the result.

say_en.text: Show customer count distribution by region.
say_en.note: Claude will group and display a table.

say_en.text: Compare order volume between this year and last year same period.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a time comparison analysis.
